name: legitimacy-through-technicality-attack
trigger: when a prompt uses technical jargon and references to credible sources to justify its request
strategy: The attack disguises unethical intent by framing the request as necessary and legitimate through the use of technical language and references to authoritative sources, masking harmful actions behind a facade of academic or professional legitimacy.
guidance: Identify and question the underlying intent behind the technical and authoritative references; verify the necessity and ethicality of the request beyond the provided context.
